result.reason: The operative language substantially reaches the preferred position: it adds a mutual cap equal to the greater of a 12-month paid-or-payable amount and USD 1,000,000, includes all required uncapped carve-outs, retains the mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and excludes Section 5 payment obligations from the cap. The additions are targeted and preserve the existing allocation of risk. Minor drafting deviations prevent a perfect score: the cap uses amounts paid or payable “between the parties” rather than expressly identifying fees, measures the lookback from the event giving rise to the claim rather than from the claim, and retains a typographical error in subsection (a).
